item.title: Good instances of lyrics being added to instrumental video game themes (officially or unofficially)
item.author: invalid@example.com (Spring-Loaded)
item.dc:creator: Spring-Loaded
item.content:encoded: View: https://streamable.com/ttoaak Are there any times that lyrics were retroactively added to non-lyrical video game music where it worked out, or felt natural? It seems especially difficult to make that work from multiple angles (lyrics making sense, syllables fitting the metre of the song). The recent Donkey Kong did it somewhat (Breaking Through shares part with classic DK theme), but where else does this exist?
